# SYNESIS_E112 — Error

## Description

ONTOLOGY field `field_name` uses a name reserved in the JSON.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The ONTOLOGY field `field_name` has the name of a key the compiler
  reserves for the concept in the JSON (concept, location, frequency, source_count,
  parent_chains; or description, when another field has ROLE NOTE DEFINITION).
  The field value would overwrite the key. Rename the field.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **ReservedOntologyFieldName**: `field_name`
